notes.title: Chapter 2 Release Date - 31st January 2017
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We are please to announce that The Secret Monster Society will have its second chapter release on Monday 31st January 2017.

Titled - "Chapter Two: Time, Dreams and Underwater Travel", this chapter will continue the story of Blithe and Aphonic and their adventure through time to stop an evil menace trying to destroy the human world.

Get set for more puzzles, funny dialogue and more investigation.

Many thanks

Deceptive Games

notes.title: Update #1
notes.notes:
Hello everyone,

We have just released an update that will squish those pesky bugs. The full patch notes can be found below.

[list]
[*] Escaping the forest now unlocks the ‘escape forest’ achievement.	
[*] Reading the book in the classroom while wearing the sunglasses no longer shows the wrong book text.
[*] Brandoon's conversation about the screwdriver doesn't show until needed.
[*] Wearing the glasses with examining the newspaper in inventory no longer renders the wrong sprites.
[*] All Blithe’s conversation now plays when talking to the grounds keeper.
[*] Rocking Horse examine text now spelt correctly.
[*] Examining a note will now display ‘read note’ instead of ‘examine read note’
[/list]

Thanks,

Deceptive Games Ltd.
